title.narrative: Sustainable Energy Sector Reform Program - Subprogram 2

description.narrative: The Program will help the Government with the short-term stabilization measures and start the long-term restructuring for a sustainable power sector. The impact of the overall program will be a sustainable energy sector that supports economic growth. The outcome will be a reliable and sustainable energy system.
